voice.text: Imagine we cut down EVERY tree in the forest today. [pause] Will new tall trees be there tomorrow? Tap your guess.
Water. Trees. Soil. Food. [pause] The things we use come from <emphasis>nature</emphasis>.
But nature is not endless. [pause] Take EVERY tree — and none are left. No wood for us. [pause] And no home for the birds.
We can replant! [pause] But a little sapling takes many, many years to grow tall. Nature does NOT refill instantly.
So we help, three different ways. [pause] <emphasis>Reduce</emphasis> means: use LESS. Turn the faucet off while you brush.
<emphasis>Reuse</emphasis> means: use a thing AGAIN. An empty jar becomes a crayon cup.
<emphasis>Recycle</emphasis> means: an old thing is made into a NEW thing. Old paper goes to the mill, and comes back as fresh paper. [pause] Three words — three different helps!
Look at what is happening. [pause] Then tap the help that fits: reduce, reuse, or recycle.
Three helps, and you know which is which! [pause] Now show what you know.
Not quite. Reduce means using LESS of something. [pause] Is that what happens here?
Not quite. Reuse means using the SAME thing again, yourself. [pause] Is that what happens here?
Not quite. Recycle means the old thing is made into a NEW thing, like at a mill. [pause] Is that what happens here?
Not quite. Berries don't refill overnight. Nature is limited — and the birds need them too.
Not quite. It DOES matter. Our choices change what is left for nature, and for wildlife.
Yes! [pause] Turning it off is reduce — using less water.
Yes! [pause] Same jar, new use. That's reuse.
Yes! [pause] Old paper made into new paper. That's recycle.
Yes! [pause] Using the same sheet again. Reuse.
Yes! [pause] Using less power. Reduce.
Yes! [pause] Melted and made new. Recycle.
Yes! [pause] Wildlife needs nature's food too. Take some, leave some.
We cut down every tree today. When will tall trees be back?
The faucet runs while you brush. Which help fits?
You draw on the back of used paper. Which help is that?
What does recycle mean?
A berry bush in the woods. The kind choice is…
<soft>You know the three helps!</soft> [pause] Well done.
Good try! Let's watch the forest once more.
